subject: Request: Steward Support Credits for OpenSynthCI
messages:
From: Alyssa Walker <alyssa@opensynth.org>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Request: Steward Support Credits for OpenSynthCI

Hi Priyom and Marissa,

Hope you’re both well — I’m Alyssa, community lead at the OpenSynth Foundation. We run OpenSynthCI, the community CI that runs test and model-checking jobs for ~120 downstream packages. Over the last three weeks our activity spiked and we ran into token throttling and queue delays that affected PRs across many projects.

We’re self-hosting an integration that calls Redwood for inference-based flake detection and release-note generation. The project is non-commercial; most contributors are volunteers. We signed up via PLG (org: opensynth) but have exhausted the free trial. Can you help with steward/community credits so CI doesn’t stall? Ideally a 3-month grant to smooth the winter release cycle: 
- Requested: $1,500 credit (approx. 75k tokens/month)
- Primary use: CI inference for tests + release-note generation
- Repo: https://github.com/opensynth/ci (public)

I’ve attached a snapshot of recent usage and a short steward application. Happy to provide any verification you need. We’re on a tight timeline — two major releases scheduled starting Sep 20.

Thanks,
Alyssa Walker
Community Lead, OpenSynth Foundation
alyssa@opensynth.org
Attachment: opensynth-usage-snapshot.csv (csv, 48KB)
Attachment: steward-application.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Walker <alyssa@opensynth.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: Steward Support Credits for OpenSynthCI

Thanks for the details, Alyssa — appreciate the clear summary and the attachments. I reviewed the usage snapshot and I can see the spike in inference calls.

A couple quick things we’ll need to proceed:
- A link to the GitHub org and a short note in the repo README confirming OpenSynth Foundation stewardship (public proof of maintainership)
- Approximate expected monthly token volume for the next 3 months (you gave a target but a ballpark/month helps budgeting)
- Confirmation that no paid customers are using the OpenSynth CI (must be community-only to qualify for steward credits)

I’m looping in Marissa (growth) and Neha (program ops) to fast-track the request. We typically authorize steward credits as a three-month grant and give a self-serve redemption link once approved. I’ll aim to get a decision in 48 hours.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Growth Operations, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:06:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Request: Steward Support Credits for OpenSynthCI

Marissa / Neha — forwarding a steward credit request from OpenSynth. Key points:
- Org: OpenSynth Foundation (community OSS steward)
- Current problem: PLG signup exhausted; CI jobs failing / long queues
- Attachments: usage snapshot (attached), steward application (attached)
- Proposed grant: $1,500 (3 months) — or we can do $500/mo for 3 months; they say ~75k tokens/mo currently but usage is spiky (see CSV)

Why I recommend approval:
- High upstream impact (120 downstream packages) -> signals strong community visibility
- Low financial risk; steward program historically nets high developer goodwill and case studies for community support

Considerations / ask:
- Approver: Marissa (growth) to sign off on amount and deal_id creation
- Ops: Neha to confirm redemption link and budget code 

Attachments: opensynth-usage-snapshot.csv

On the timeline: they need help before Sep 20 to avoid release disruptions. If we approve today I can issue a redemption URL that automatically applies a credit to their org once they confirm the org admin.

—Priyom

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the patience. We’ve approved a steward support grant for OpenSynth Foundation: $1,500 of credits, valid for 90 days.

How it works: I’ve provisioned a self-serve redemption link that an org admin can claim. When claimed, the credit is applied to the OpenSynth org account and we’ll notify you by email. Please have your org admin confirm via the link below and we’ll monitor usage.

Redemption link: https://console.redwood.ai/credits/redeem?code=OSS-STEW-0912
Reference: Deal OSS-2026-0912-01

Attachment: steward-grant-terms.pdf (pdf, 12KB) — contains the usual steward terms (community-only usage, 90-day expiry, modest audit right).

If you’d like, we can schedule a brief 20-minute call to walk through best-practice batching and prefix caching suggestions to stretch the credits further. We typically recommend enabling small prefix caches for CI to reduce warm KV-cache cost.

Congrats — look forward to seeing OpenSynth keep CI green.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Growth, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: steward-grant-terms.pdf
